function renderRetry(){if(!state.results.length){const o=getStored();state.results=o.lastResults||[];state.attemptStatus=o.attemptStatus||'none'}if(!state.results.length){$('#retryHost').innerHTML='<div class="panel"><b>No attempt data yet.</b><p>Start the Full IELTS Test. const originalSaveStored=saveStored;

function laCoursePaint(status){
 if(!status)return;

 if(!panel){panel=document.createElement('p');panel.id='la-course-progress';panel.className='muted';panel.setAttribute('role','status');document.getElementById('activityCards')?.before(panel);}
